title: Standing in Ulrick's shin
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: the sand floor of the Grand Arena in Fireholm, tiered stone stands full of cheering crowds, rocks scattered for cover. Ulrick: a broad-shouldered human paladin with short swept-back dark brown hair and a full dark beard, wearing heavy dark plate armour with bronze-orange pauldrons and a long white cloth tabard over the armour, wielding a long glaive; magically enlarged to about sixty feet tall, towering over the arena and swinging a colossal glaive the length of a ship's mast. At his feet, tiny by comparison, Durzo: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour, holding a pair of daggers; he is crouched right beside Ulrick's enormous shin, daggers ready, using the giant as cover. Low camera angle looking up at the giant.
